The '''Inquisitorium dark trooper''' was a model of [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] used by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Design==
Inquisitorium dark troopers served the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisition]],<ref name="SWG:Fotp" /> an organization of [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] tasked with hunting down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|105|Inquisitorius}}</ref>

This [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] design was a variant of the [[Phase III Dark Trooper|Phase III dark troopers]]. These dark troopers used heavy weapons, but relied on pistols and shock staffs as well, despite the trooper's clunky size. They used tactics such as [[attack pattern Ignimus]]. Inquisitorium dark troopers sometimes worked alongside [[Inquisitorium hunter]]s.<ref name="SWG:Fotp" />

==History==
A group of Inquisitorium dark troopers and Inquisitorium hunters were deployed on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to hunt and kill the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xos]]. However, Xos was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] briefly before the Inquisitorius forces localized the Dark Jedi in the [[Southern Jedi Ruins]].<ref name="SWG:Fotp" />

==Behind the scenes==
Inquisitorium dark troopers were [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Fotp" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Inquisitorium dark troopers were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:Fotp" />
